scope: Bounded factual source packet for exact frozen cases 168 and 181. No probabilities, prediction-market quote/book, valuation, recommendation, or account action.

frozen_rules.question: Will Tesla be the largest company in the world by market cap on December 31?
frozen_rules.resolution: Largest company worldwide by market capitalization on December 31, 2026, at market close; resolution by consensus of credible reporting.

frozen_rules.question: Saints vs. Giants
frozen_rules.resolution: 2026-10-18 1:00 PM ET (17:00 UTC): Saints win -> Saints; Giants win -> Giants; overtime included; tie -> 50/50; postponement remains open until played; cancellation without make-up -> 50/50.

market_cap_ranking.date_binding_note: The captured ranking values TSLA at $354.72, matching Yahoo chart’s October 16 close; October 16 association is therefore an inference from matching prices, not a page-provided as-of date.

filing_share_count_context.note: Q2 filing says no Q2 expense for the performance-based awards because achieving their conditions was considered improbable. These awards are a potential dilution item, not a forecast.

weighted_average_not_outstanding.note: EPS weighted-average figures differ from actual shares outstanding; restricted awards are excluded until earned.

shares_and_dilution.repurchase_evidence: No “repurchase” or “treasury stock” text hit in the captured Q2 10-Q. This does not establish absence of activity after the filing date.

vendor_conflict.conflict: CMC displayed 3.237B is materially below SEC’s 3.949547394B as of July 16 and exactly matches the Q2 basic weighted-average EPS count. CMC’s global TSLA cap and displayed price imply approximately 3.946B shares, close to SEC actual count. The vendor page is internally inconsistent; do not substitute its share-count field for SEC outstanding shares.

public_private_comparator_note.fact: SpaceX was publicly listed as Nasdaq: SPCX in June 2026; issuer said shares began trading June 12, and the issuer announced full underwriters’ option closing June 15. The CMC Oct 18 ranking lists SPCX at rank 7.

Yahoo secondary data shows $160.95 on June 12. This price issue does not alter public-listing status.

limitations: No probabilities, forecasting, prediction-market prices/books, or investment judgment were produced.
CompaniesMarketCap ranking and shares page have no explicit machine-readable as-of timestamp; the ranking date link is inferred from TSLA price matching Oct 16 close.
Tesla CMC share-count field conflicts with SEC filing; SEC figure is older but primary. No post-July 16 SEC outstanding-share count was fetched.
No claim is made that the retrieved list exhausts all possible companies relevant to the worldwide market-cap resolution rule.
Sportsbook odds differ by book and snapshot; no implied probability was computed.
